en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Couplets beginning with the Defilements (Kilesadukādi).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not an affliction, there arises an afflictive state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are three [answers] for the root condition … pe … three for the non-disappearance condition.
